description: The plot (d) in Figure 8 shows the performance of knowledge probing on Qwen2.5 after editing with different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^1 to 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and ranges from 60% to 80%. The plot includes five lines representing different methods: Base (black line), MEND (brown line), FT (red line), MEMIT (purple line), IKE (blue line), and ROME (green line). The Base line starts at approximately 65% and ends at around 70%, showing a slight increase. The MEND line starts at about 65% and ends near 75%, indicating a significant improvement. The FT line starts at around 65% and ends at about 70%, showing a moderate increase. The MEMIT line starts at approximately 65% and ends near 75%, similar to the MEND line. The IKE line starts at about 65% and ends at around 70%, showing a slight increase. The ROME line starts at around 65% and ends at about 75%, indicating a significant improvement. The plot illustrates that the editing methods MEND and ROME show the most substantial improvements in performance on Qwen2.5.
